title: FreeStyle LibreLink – SK
meta_description: Approved for use with FreeStyle Libre sensors.
full_description: The FreeStyle LibreLink app is approved for use with the FreeStyle Libre sensor. Now you can check your glucose level by scanning the sensor with your phone.You can use FreeStyle LibreLink to:* display of current glucose data, glucose trend arrow and glucose history,* viewing reports such as Time in Range and Daily Patterns,* providing data to the doctor and family with your consent.COMPATIBILITY WITH SMARTPHONESCompatibility may vary by phone and operating system. For more information on compatible phones, visit http://FreeStyleLibre.com.USING THE APP AND THE READER WITH THE SAME SENSORYou can use the FreeStyle LibreLink app and the reader with the same sensor. First trigger the sensor with the reader and then scan it with your phone.Remember that the application and the reader do not share data with each other. You can get complete information in the device by scanning the sensor every 8 hours with this device. Otherwise, your reports won't include all of your data. You can upload and view data from all devices on LibreView.com.APPLICATION INFORMATIONThe FreeStyle LibreLink application in combination with the sensor is designed to measure glucose levels in people with diabetes. For more information on how to use the FreeStyle LibreLink app, please refer to the user manual accessible through the app. If you need a printed instruction manual, please contact Abbott Diabetes Care Customer Support.Consult a healthcare professional to determine if this product is right for you or if you have questions about the use of this product in making treatment decisions.For more information, visit http://FreeStyleLibre.com.[1] If you use the FreeStyle LibreLink app, you must also have access to a blood glucose monitoring system, as this app does not provide one.[2] Use of FreeStyle LibreLink and LibreLinkUp requires LibreView registration.FreeStyle, Libre, and related brands are trademarks of Abbott. Other trademarks are the property of their respective owners.For additional legal notices and terms of use, please visit http://FreeStyleLibre.com.========To resolve any technical or customer issues with FreeStyle Libre, please contact FreeStyle Libre Customer Service directly.
